caption: The drawing features three objects, all positioned near the upper center of a cream-colored background that fades to a darker beige at the top. The most prominent object is a detailed gold or brass ring designed to resemble a belt, complete with buckle, holes, and stitching; the ring is rendered with shading to give it a three-dimensional appearance. Below and to the left of this ring are two smaller, partially sketched shapes in gray pencil: one appears to be a curved form with pointed ends and hatch marks, possibly representing a side or internal view of the ring, while the other sketch is a short, straight, and slightly tapered rectangle with a small circle and line, which could be another view or a component of the ring. The composition is sparse with no background elements and all focus is on the three central objects.
title: Tie Clasp
